paragraphs.text: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
paragraphs.original: Ἀρχὴ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Ἰησοῦ χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Archē tou euangeliou Iēsou christou.

paragraphs.text: Even as it is written in Isaiah the prophet, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way.
paragraphs.original: Καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ Ἠσαΐᾳ τῷ προφήτῃ· Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου, ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου·
paragraphs.translit: Kathōs gegraptai en tō Ēsaia tō prophētē· Idou apostellō ton angelon mou pro prosōpou sou, hos kataskeuasei tēn hodon sou·

paragraphs.text: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight;
paragraphs.original: φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō· Hetoimasate tēn hodon kyriou, eutheias poieite tas tribous autou,

paragraphs.text: John came, who baptized in the wilderness and preached the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins.
paragraphs.original: ἐγένετο Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν.
paragraphs.translit: egeneto Iōannēs ho baptizōn en tē erēmō kēryssōn baptisma metanoias eis aphesin hamartiōn.

paragraphs.text: And there went out unto him all the country of Judaea, and all they of Jerusalem; And they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία χώρα καὶ οἱ Ἱεροσολυμῖται πάντες, καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai exeporeueto pros auton pasa hē Ioudaia chōra kai hoi Hierosolymitai pantes, kai ebaptizonto hypʼ autou en tō Iordanē potamō exomologoumenoi tas hamartias autōn.

paragraphs.text: And John was clothed with camel`s hair, and [had] a leathern girdle about his loins, and did eat locusts and wild honey.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἦν ὁ Ἰωάννης ἐνδεδυμένος τρίχας καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσθων ἀκρίδας καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēn ho Iōannēs endedymenos trichas kamēlou kai zōnēn dermatinēn peri tēn osphyn autou, kai esthōn akridas kai meli agrion.

paragraphs.text: And he preached, saying, There cometh after me he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐκήρυσσεν λέγων· Ἔρχεται ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου ὀπίσω μου, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς κύψας λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: kai ekēryssen legōn· Erchetai ho ischyroteros mou opisō mou, hou ouk eimi hikanos kypsas lysai ton himanta tōn hypodēmatōn autou·

paragraphs.text: I baptized you in water; But he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ ἐβάπτισα ὑμᾶς ὕδατι, αὐτὸς δὲ βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: egō ebaptisa hymas hydati, autos de baptisei hymas en pneumati hagiō.

paragraphs.text: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in the Jordan.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲτ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη εἰς τὸν Ἰορδάνην ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου.
paragraphs.translit: Kai egeneto en ekeinais tais hēmerais ēlthen Iēsous apo Nazaret tēs Galilaias kai ebaptisthē eis ton Iordanēn hypo Iōannou.

paragraphs.text: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent asunder, and the Spirit as a dove descending upon him:
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος εἶδεν σχιζομένους τοὺς οὐρανοὺς καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα ὡς περιστερὰν καταβαῖνον εἰς αὐτόν·
paragraphs.translit: kai euthys anabainōn ek tou hydatos eiden schizomenous tous ouranous kai to pneuma hōs peristeran katabainon eis auton·

paragraphs.text: And a voice came out of the heavens, Thou art my beloved Son, in thee I am well pleased.
paragraphs.original: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν· Σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.
paragraphs.translit: kai phōnē egeneto ek tōn ouranōn· Sy ei ho hyios mou ho agapētos, en soi eudokēsa.

paragraphs.text: And straightway the Spirit driveth him forth into the wilderness.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτὸν ἐκβάλλει εἰς τὴν ἔρημον.
paragraphs.translit: Kai euthys to pneuma auton ekballei eis tēn erēmon.

paragraphs.text: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted of Satan; And he was with the wild beasts; And the angels ministered unto him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἦν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ, καὶ ἦν μετὰ τῶν θηρίων, καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι διηκόνουν αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēn en tē erēmō tesserakonta hēmeras peirazomenos hypo tou Satana, kai ēn meta tōn thēriōn, kai hoi angeloi diēkonoun autō.

paragraphs.text: Now after John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,
paragraphs.original: Καὶ μετὰ τὸ παραδοθῆναι τὸν Ἰωάννην ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ
paragraphs.translit: Kai meta to paradothēnai ton Iōannēn ēlthen ho Iēsous eis tēn Galilaian kēryssōn to euangelion tou theou

paragraphs.text: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe in the gospel.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγων ὅτι Πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ· μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: kai legōn hoti Peplērōtai ho kairos kai ēngiken hē basileia tou theou· metanoeite kai pisteuete en tō euangeliō.

paragraphs.text: And passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net in the sea; for they were fishers.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ παράγων παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν Σίμωνα καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν Σίμωνος ἀμφιβάλλοντας ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλιεῖς·
paragraphs.translit: Kai paragōn para tēn thalassan tēs Galilaias eiden Simōna kai Andrean ton adelphon Simōnos amphiballontas en tē thalassē, ēsan gar halieis·

paragraphs.text: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου, καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς γενέσθαι ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων.
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen autois ho Iēsous· Deute opisō mou, kai poiēsō hymas genesthai halieis anthrōpōn.

paragraphs.text: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai euthys aphentes ta diktya ēkolouthēsan autō.

paragraphs.text: And going on a little further, he saw James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προβὰς ὀλίγον εἶδεν Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα,
paragraphs.translit: kai probas oligon eiden Iakōbon ton tou Zebedaiou kai Iōannēn ton adelphon autou, kai autous en tō ploiō katartizontas ta diktya,

paragraphs.text: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς. καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν Ζεβεδαῖον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ τῶν μισθωτῶν ἀπῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai euthys ekalesen autous. kai aphentes ton patera autōn Zebedaion en tō ploiō meta tōn misthōtōn apēlthon opisō autou.

paragraphs.text: And they go into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εἰσπορεύονται εἰς Καφαρναούμ. καὶ εὐθὺς τοῖς σάββασιν ἐδίδασκεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eisporeuontai eis Kapharnaoum. kai euthys tois sabbasin edidasken eis tēn synagōgēn.

paragraphs.text: And they were astonished at his teaching: For he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ, ἦν γὰρ διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐξουσίαν ἔχων καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai exeplēssonto epi tē didachē autou, ēn gar didaskōn autous hōs exousian echōn kai ouch hōs hoi grammateis.

paragraphs.text: And straightway there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἦν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπος ἐν πνεύματι ἀκαθάρτῳ καὶ ἀνέκραξεν
paragraphs.translit: kai euthys ēn en tē synagōgē autōn anthrōpos en pneumati akathartō kai anekraxen

paragraphs.text: saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
paragraphs.original: λέγων· Τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ; ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς; οἶδά σε τίς εἶ, ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: legōn· Ti hēmin kai soi, Iēsou Nazarēne; ēlthes apolesai hēmas; oida se tis ei, ho hagios tou theou.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων· Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai epetimēsen autō ho Iēsous legōn· Phimōthēti kai exelthe ex autou.

paragraphs.text: And the unclean spirit, tearing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ σπαράξαν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον καὶ φωνῆσαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai sparaxan auton to pneuma to akatharton kai phōnēsan phōnē megalē exēlthen ex autou.

paragraphs.text: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐθαμβήθησαν ἅπαντες, ὥστε συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντας· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο; διδαχὴ καινή· κατʼ ἐξουσίαν καὶ τοῖς πνεύμασι τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις ἐπιτάσσει, καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ethambēthēsan hapantes, hōste syzētein pros heautous legontas· Ti estin touto; didachē kainē· katʼ exousian kai tois pneumasi tois akathartois epitassei, kai hypakouousin autō.

paragraphs.text: And the report of him went out straightway everywhere into all the region of Galilee round about.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εὐθὺς πανταχοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον τῆς Γαλιλαίας.
paragraphs.translit: kai exēlthen hē akoē autou euthys pantachou eis holēn tēn perichōron tēs Galilaias.

paragraphs.text: And straightway, when they were come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐξελθόντες ἦλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου.
paragraphs.translit: Kai euthys ek tēs synagōgēs exelthontes ēlthon eis tēn oikian Simōnos kai Andreou meta Iakōbou kai Iōannou.

paragraphs.text: Now Simon`s wife`s mother lay sick of a fever; and straightway they tell him of her:
paragraphs.original: ἡ δὲ πενθερὰ Σίμωνος κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα, καὶ εὐθὺς λέγουσιν αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς.
paragraphs.translit: hē de penthera Simōnos katekeito pyressousa, kai euthys legousin autō peri autēs.

paragraphs.text: and he came and took her by the hand, and raised her up; and the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προσελθὼν ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός· καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός, καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai proselthōn ēgeiren autēn kratēsas tēs cheiros· kai aphēken autēn ho pyretos, kai diēkonei autois.

paragraphs.text: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were sick, and them that were possessed with demons.
paragraphs.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης, ὅτε ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος, ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους·
paragraphs.translit: Opsias de genomenēs, hote edy ho hēlios, epheron pros auton pantas tous kakōs echontas kai tous daimonizomenous·

paragraphs.text: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἦν ὅλη ἡ πόλις ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēn holē hē polis episynēgmenē pros tēn thyran.

paragraphs.text: And he healed many that were sick with divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and he suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις, καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλεν, καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν λαλεῖν τὰ δαιμόνια, ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai etherapeusen pollous kakōs echontas poikilais nosois, kai daimonia polla exebalen, kai ouk ēphien lalein ta daimonia, hoti ēdeisan auton.

paragraphs.text: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ πρωῒ ἔννυχα λίαν ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κἀκεῖ προσηύχετο.
paragraphs.translit: Kai prōi ennycha lian anastas exēlthen kai apēlthen eis erēmon topon kakei prosēucheto.

paragraphs.text: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him;
paragraphs.original: καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν Σίμων καὶ οἱ μετʼ αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: kai katediōxen auton Simōn kai hoi metʼ autou,

paragraphs.text: and they found him, and say unto him, All are seeking thee.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πάντες ζητοῦσίν σε.
paragraphs.translit: kai heuron auton kai legousin autō hoti Pantes zētousin se.

paragraphs.text: And he saith unto them, Let us go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also; for to this end came I forth.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἄγωμεν ἀλλαχοῦ εἰς τὰς ἐχομένας κωμοπόλεις, ἵνα καὶ ἐκεῖ κηρύξω, εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐξῆλθον.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autois· Agōmen allachou eis tas echomenas kōmopoleis, hina kai ekei kēryxō, eis touto gar exēlthon.

paragraphs.text: And he went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἦλθεν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν εἰς ὅλην τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλων.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēlthen kēryssōn eis tas synagōgas autōn eis holēn tēn Galilaian kai ta daimonia ekballōn.

paragraphs.text: And there cometh to him a leper, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λεπρὸς παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ γονυπετῶν λέγων αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.
paragraphs.translit: Kai erchetai pros auton lepros parakalōn auton kai gonypetōn legōn autō hoti Ean thelēs dynasai me katharisai.

paragraphs.text: And being moved with compassion, he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou made clean.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὀργισθεὶς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἥψατο καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Θέλω, καθαρίσθητι·
paragraphs.translit: kai orgistheis ekteinas tēn cheira autou hēpsato kai legei autō· Thelō, katharisthēti·

paragraphs.text: And straightway the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα, καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθη.
paragraphs.translit: kai euthys apēlthen apʼ autou hē lepra, kai ekatharisthē.

paragraphs.text: And he strictly charged him, and straightway sent him out,
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐμβριμησάμενος αὐτῷ εὐθὺς ἐξέβαλεν αὐτόν,
paragraphs.translit: kai embrimēsamenos autō euthys exebalen auton,

paragraphs.text: and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Ὅρα μηδενὶ μηδὲν εἴπῃς, ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκε περὶ τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ σου ἃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autō· Hora mēdeni mēden eipēs, alla hypage seauton deixon tō hierei kai prosenenke peri tou katharismou sou ha prosetaxen Mōysēs eis martyrion autois.

paragraphs.text: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to spread abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ ἐξελθὼν ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν πολλὰ καὶ διαφημίζειν τὸν λόγον, ὥστε μηκέτι αὐτὸν δύνασθαι φανερῶς εἰς πόλιν εἰσελθεῖν, ἀλλὰ ἔξω ἐπʼ ἐρήμοις τόποις ἦν· καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντοθεν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de exelthōn ērxato kēryssein polla kai diaphēmizein ton logon, hōste mēketi auton dynasthai phanerōs eis polin eiselthein, alla exō epʼ erēmois topois ēn· kai ērchonto pros auton pantothen.
